digest.component_or_area: documentation and test infrastructure for metrics/code-health surface
propositions: The [metrics] pip extra must be documented as a prerequisite containing lizard, with scc and jscpd as separate PATH requirements
The [code_health] config section keys, types, and defaults must be documented in docs/config.md
The three-part adoption workflow (pip install rebar[metrics] + external CLIs on PATH) and analyzer unavailability fallback must be documented in docs/user-guide.md

A new test test_metrics_surface_documented must assert the presence of [metrics], scc, and jscpd keywords in reuse-surface.md, [code_health] in config.md, and rebar[metrics] with fallback language in user-guide.md
Existing tests/scripts/test_metrics_docs.py (ticket 121b) must be extended rather than replaced with parallel tests
